cial nutritional support are likely to continue and to vary with time and from country to country. Intestinal transplantation is
becoming a potentially realistic option for a few patients with irreversible intestinal failure who cannot be adequately maintained
on long-term PN, but it has not yet become part of routine clinical care in the same way as renal transplantation has become routine
in patients with renal failure, who would otherwise receive a lifelong treatment with dialysis.
